d:
The search for Bigfoot takes the team deeper into the wilderness, where every strange sound, unexplained sighting and possible piece of evidence could bring them closer to the truth. From tracking mysterious movements to investigating fresh leads, the team faces unpredictable challenges at every turn. But will their discoveries finally provide conclusive evidence of Bigfoot's existence, or will the mystery remain elusive?
Watch Expedition Bigfoot, Season 4, Episodes 2, 7, 8, 5, 1, 4 and 3, on Discovery Channel India.
